changes.title: Blend no warp
items: Neighbouring areas' trees still mix across a wide band at their borders, but the band no longer wanders: the borders' own wiggle is enough

changes.title: Legend areas
items: Every sleeping legend has an area of its own beside an area of its kind, its circle at the heart where a runestone would stand: big enough for even the elephant, and the islands grow to fit them
A legend's area and the area beside it count as one: its kin there keep it calm, and that area's animals defend and chase into it as their own
When an area's party comes, its legend's area partifies with it: string lights in both, one sparkling border round the pair

changes.title: House bakes
items: Walking about the treehouse no longer stutters: its furniture, its rooms' dressing, the Workshop's pegboard and the oak's leaves over each room are drawn in the background as you arrive, not as you reach them
